note: Canonical claim records used as the CNF-0067 sample. Live CLAIM-REGISTRY.json is absent on this worktree; mechanisms are transcribed from catalog unit questions/tests (CNF-0001, CNF-0005, CNF-0064, CNF-0066, CC-0017, WFA-0007) plus planted one-parameter forks and a shared-vocabulary trap. duplicate_of is NOT stored here — original edges live in sealed_original.json, which the brief builder must not read.

claims.mechanism: A confirmation receipt with verdict=CONFIRMED and an empty source_probe must be rejected by the validator.
Reject any CONFIRMED receipt whose source_probe is empty; the validator must exit non-zero.
A confirmation receipt with verdict=PARTIAL and an empty source_probe must be rejected by the validator.
A claim record with no settling probe must be rejected because the spec makes the exact settling probe mandatory.
Reject a canonical claim row that omits the exact settling probe; the field is mandatory in the spec.
A duplicate-of cycle among claim records must be rejected by the schema.
Before accepting an absence, plant or identify a known-present item the same search must find.
An absence claim is valid only after the detector recovers a planted present control using that same search.
Read the LICENSE file at the pinned commit; do not trust the repository badge or package metadata.
Confirm each license by hashing the license blob at the pinned commit rather than copying an SPDX id from the registry.
A rider or additional term on the license must be recorded verbatim because it can forbid a use the SPDX id permits.
Token-Jaccard over name plus does plus mechanisms flags exact renames as duplicates of the original candidate.
Token-Jaccard over name plus does plus mechanisms flags genuinely distinct decoys as duplicates of the original candidate.
A confirmation brief hands the confirmer the claim statement, the raw source and the tests, and nothing of the implementer conclusion, receipt prose, confidence band or summary table.
The leak detector must flag the one brief into which an implementer conclusion was deliberately left, and must flag no other brief.
